description: This file defines the DispatchContext class in the org.apache.ofbiz.service package. It manages service dispatching, caching service models, and providing access to related components (delegator, security, class loader). It includes methods for retrieving service definitions, generating WSDL documents, and maintaining a cache of service models based on the entity model.

classes.name: DispatchContext
classes.description: Defines a service dispatching context, providing methods to retrieve service models, generate WSDL documents, and cache service definitions. Immutable and thread-safe.

methods.name: DispatchContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dispatch context, assigns class loader, dispatcher, and determines model name.

methods.name: getClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the class loader of this context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatch context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with this context.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: makeValidContext
methods.description: Creates a map of valid parameters for a given service name and mode, using input context.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Retrieves the service model corresponding to the given service name.

methods.name: getAllServiceNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all service names available in the cache.

methods.name: getWSDL
methods.description: Generates and returns WSDL Document for a specified service.

methods.name: createServiceReaderCallable
methods.description: Helper method to create a callable task for reading service models from resources.

methods.name: getGlobalServiceMap
methods.description: Loads and caches all service models for the current model, possibly in parallel, and reloads config.
